additional_info.subject: 7ZnWL5 - Analysis
additional_info.body:
The charger sends meter public keys in MeterConfiguration via the DataTransfer message and the SD key via the StopTransaction message.
On August 12th, during a reboot, the charger sent an "unknown" public key for connector 1. As a result, all sessions on connector 1 showed an invalid signature in the OCPP backend until the correct public key was sent on August 19th.
Logs from the reboot on August 12th show that the outlets were ready and the LEM meter was functioning correctly.
This issue has happened twice in the past year, with the previous occurrence on October 25th, 2023, affecting connector 2.
We need to discuss with R&D why the charger sent an unknown public key for connector 1.
I suspect this could be due to an issue with the LEM, possibly failing to communicate the correct public key to the PLC.
